import Ramsey

open Ramsey
open Ramsey.d18.k1

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

example : Complete {G | ReducedClass G} (Ramsey.d18.KClass 1) := reduction

example {S : Set (SimpleGraph (Fin 43))} (h : Complete S ReducedClass) :
    Complete S (Ramsey.d18.KClass 1) := complete_of_reduced h

example (h : Complete ∅ ReducedClass) : Ramsey.d18.ExcludesSubcase .k1 :=
  excludes_of_reduced h

example (K : Key) (X : K.Matrix) : IsRamseyGraph 5 5 (K.assemble X) ↔ K.Valid X :=
  K.assemble_ramsey_iff X

example (K : Key) : Nat.card K.Matrix = 2 ^ 289 := K.matrix_card

example (K : Key) : Function.Injective K.assemble := K.assemble_injective

example (K : Key) (X : K.Matrix) (h : K.Valid X) :
    (K.assembledFrame X).parameters.Allowed := (K.valid_filters X h).parameters

example {G : SimpleGraph (Fin 43)} (F : Frame G) (hF : F.Admissible) :
    64 ≤ crossEdgeCount G F.C F.T ∧ 64 ≤ crossEdgeCount G F.D F.T := by
  exact ⟨attachment_cross_ge_sixty_four hF.ramsey_C hF.card_C hF.side_C
    F.disjoint_CT hF.card_T,
    attachment_cross_ge_sixty_four hF.ramsey_D hF.card_D hF.side_D
      F.disjoint_DT hF.card_T⟩

example {G : SimpleGraph (Fin 43)} (hG : IsRamseyGraph 5 5 G)
    (v : Fin 43) (hv : Ramsey.deg G v = 18)
    (hK : Ramsey.d18.IsKNeighborhood 1 (G.induce (G.neighborSet v))) :
    ∃ F : Frame G, F.v = v ∧ F.Admissible ∧ F.parameters.Allowed := by
  obtain ⟨F, hf, ha⟩ := exists_admissible hG v hv hK
  exact ⟨F, hf, ha, F.parameters_allowed ha hG⟩

example {G : SimpleGraph (Fin 43)} (F : Frame G) (hF : F.Admissible) :
    (G.induce F.C).IsSRGWith 17 8 3 4 := by
  classical
  exact core_isSRGWith hF.ramsey_C hF.card_C

example (S : {p : Parameters // p.Allowed} → Set (SimpleGraph (Fin 43)))
    (h : ∀ p, Complete (S p) (ParameterClass p.val)) :
    Complete (⋃ p, S p) (Ramsey.d18.KClass 1) := complete_by_parameters S h

#print axioms Ramsey.d18.k1.reduction
#print axioms Ramsey.d18.k1.ramsey_iff_compatible
#print axioms Ramsey.d18.k1.attachment_cross_ge_sixty_four
